name: Pinoy Big Brother: Celebrity Edition
description: The celebrity edition of the reality game show "Pinoy Big Brother" features Filipino Celebrity housemates live together, share their stories and build meaningful relationships as they do tasks and challenges supervised by Big Brother. Every week a nomination is done, and the public decides who gets evicted and eventually become the Big Winner of the program.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Joining the first eight housemates introduced in season two, episode one, Gaby enters the house riding a "twister bike" (basically a child's trike) along a ramp that leads to the pool.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Mcoy and Zara entered the House in two different instances. Mcoy sang Pinoy Ako directly inside the confession room and later entered the House. Later, Zara was escorted into the House by Baron. Will accidentally fell into the pool while still wearing his lapel microphone. As a result, Big Brother gave Will a handheld microphone in place of his then-wet lapel microphone.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Mariel brought Jon into the House, but Big Brother trapped her inside the House. She was later made into a "celebrity house guest." Ethel was welcomed with a small party organized by Big Brother. Ruben, being in the same profession as Ethel, was tasked to host the party.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Marylaine, Will, and Mariel became the first three housemates to use the punishment room for various offenses. Will and Mariel peeled a bowl of lanzones using their mouths, and Marylaine shed coats of squash seeds.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Will finally had his lapel microphone returned to him, but he had to get past cockroaches and other insects to get it. Marylaine and Jen were put in the punishment room for a violation Jen committed. Their bickering continued there while installing train tracks used in the weekly task. The entire task took overnight, but the two eventually reconciled.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The first HOH competition was held wherein the housemates wore giant "hands" and played a game similar the Japanese game of karuta using colors. Ethel won in that game.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Donnie and Marylaine finally have several of their clothes after Gaby and Victor packed some of their things just to make it happen.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Gaby momentarily left the House to compete in a Formula Three race in the Subic International Speedway. She finish first in the second heat of the competition. Main primetime host Toni became the new houseguest.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The second HOH competition was held, involving children's trikes. Riza, Ruben, and Will won in each of the three preliminary heats, with Riza winning the final round and the title of Head of Household.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Mcoy, Victor, and Riza temporarily left the House to help embalm the body of a man who had been dead for a month due to a heart attack and whose family had no money for a proper embalming, let alone a decent funeral. Inside of the House during the absence of the trio, the other housemates also did Halloween-related tasks also to help the said man's family.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Baron smashed a pane of the living room table with his foot. The table was taken out to be repaired. Later, after the housemates partied with Bea Alonzo and John Lloyd Cruz in a black-attire party, they saw that every other table in the House was gone. In particular, the long dining table was replaced with two panes of glass on which they would eat, with some housemates acting as one pane's "table legs."

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Toni was told that she could leave the House. But before she left, she wrote and recited a poem to the housemates, saying thank you to them.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Yayo was taken to the hospital due to high blood pressure as recommended by the doctor. She returned to the house the next day. Ethel accidentally broke a very small part of the chandelier in the men's bedroom while tossing throw pillows with several of the housemates. As a result, all seven male housemates were incarcerated in the punishment room while Big Brother decided on the punishment to be given to them.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Baron, Donald, Will, and Ruben participated in a task of balancing a number of plastic goblets in a failed attempt to salvage their weekly budget. Later, the housemates came to the aid of Peggy, the pig they were nursing as part of their Season-Long Task, as the sow had given birth to a total of ten piglets, nine alive and one stillborn.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: The housemates christened Peggy's nine live piglets, even giving them names such as "Posh," "Sweet," and "B-Boy" to mention a few. Later, Gaby was given time to decide whether she would make an exit to attend a seminar in the United States or not.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The third HOH competition was held involving human bowling pins and a swinging bowling ball. The Geisler brothers, represented by Donald, won the title of HOH. Later, Gaby ultimately decided to make the exit and attend the said seminar. Furthermore, Ethel, with the help of Ruben, finished a new table using giant pick up sticks from an earlier game. Big Brother not only lauded the new table; he also made it the new living room center table to replace the glass one smashed by Baron. Along with the new table was the return of the remaining good tables in the House.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Ethel requested a home pregnancy test from Big Brother to confirm this possibility. The next day, when she had her test, it came out negative.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: On the wee hours, Jon, who was deeply distraught over the news of his aunt's death, temporarily left the House on the wee hours of Day 26 to visit his aunt's funeral, personally offer the flower arrangement he helped Ethel make, and pay his last respects to her. It was already morning when he returned to the House.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Victor, Mcoy, Riza, Gaby, and Megan picked the short straws and were sent by Big Brother to the Cebu Provincial Detention and Rehabilitation Center to dance The Breakfast Club's Rico Mambo with its inmates. The five returned to the House in the afternoon. Later, Jon, while blindfolded, had a 100-second encounter with his mother.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Ethel threatened to leave the House without Big Brother's consent, even toying with a small straight razor. Fearing for her life, the other housemates stopped her and urged her to speak with Big Brother.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: The fourth HOH competition was held, involving the housemates hanging onto punching bags for as long as they could without touching the ground. Victor, Jon, and Will were the only ones left hanging after fifteen minutes. Will would eventually become the winner of title.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Big Brother started to mete out punishments on housemates who committed violations.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: The Geislers, Jon, and Riza were "nominated for eviction." Unbeknownst to the housemates, the nomination round was really just a mock one.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: A mock eviction night was held wherein the Geisler brothers were "evicted" from the House. Upon exit, they were led by Toni to an empty Eviction Hall and from there they were brought back to the confession room. At the confession room, the brothers found out that the whole process was a hoax because Big Brother wanted to tell them that he had decided to abolish their 2-in-1 connection (which was already planned by Big Brother).

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: After having a 100-second encounter with their mother, Baron decided that Donald would be the one who should continue his stay in the House. Baron did not leave completely as viewers were made to decide through a 24-hour viewer poll on whether Baron's stay should be extended.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: On the wee hours, Mcoy and Ethel decided to make a voluntary exit and soon after left the House after conflicts involving the weekly task fumed the two. Accusations of plagiarism caused conflicts between Mcoy and Big Brother while Ethel went with Mcoy because of her already existent plans to leave. Later Baron found out that he could return to the House, as 91.69% of those who voted in the viewer poll agreed to have him back inside.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: In an episode of Über wherein Mcoy and Ethel were guests, Big Brother subsequently apologized to Mcoy about any misunderstanding they had during that time, to which Mcoy accepted.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: After nominations were announced, Angel Locsin entered the House dressed as a sniper, shooting orange paintball pellets at the unarmed male housemates.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Angel, Mariel and six of the housemates went out of the House to a firing range to learn and test their use of a .45 caliber pistol. Baron and Yayo were left behind in the House as part of their punishment; Baron broke another glass goblet days before while Yayo accidentally chipped a drinking glass. The two spent the time cleaning the House and making food for the housemates. It was during their final chore-washing Big Brother's car-that they found out that Gaby had returned. The other housemates also greeted Gaby upon their return.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: The fifth HOH competition was held. It involved the housemates crossing a beam over the swimming pool in the shortest time after being spun ten times over a rotating platform. Will was declared the winner. But the next day, citing Mariel's observation and a review of the game, Big Brother decided to transfer the title to Baron.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Gladys entered the House and after some introductions and greetings, she sang karaoke with them.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Victor and Riza temporarily left the House to engage in a wakeboarding task in Batangas in which Victor won. The two returned to the house later in the afternoon. Later, Big Brother relayed to the housemates some brief reports (with some fabrications inserted) relating to the stand-off at the Manila Peninsula Hotel.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: International R&B artist Akon visited the House after having a concert the previous night despite the curfew after the Manila Peninsula siege. Mariel, Gladys, Donnie, Jon, and Victor, who were winners in an earlier charades game, personally greeted the artist inside the confession room for 100 seconds. To be fair, Big Brother let the rest of the Housemates meet Akon, but only for ten seconds. Akon spent a short time inside the House because of his tight schedule.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Mariel was finally told by Big Brother that she could make her postponed exit. She let her say her goodbyes to the housemates and left the House area's front doors before her 100-second period expired. After a few minutes and a quick change of wardrobe, Mariel returned to her hosting duties.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: The sixth HOH competition was held wherein winners of seven mini-games must select a fellow housemate to leave a boat floating on the swimming pool. Mini-games played include picking cards, flying paper airplanes, drinking distasteful food, and blowing whistles among others. After the mini-games, Jon and Donald were the ones left on the boat, but the decision who would be the HOH rested on the other housemates. Jon got the nod of four out of the seven housemates, earning him the title.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Peggy, the pig the housemates were tending to as part of their Season-Long Task, was given away to her new owners. The housemates who were saddened by the pig's departure, would still continue to take care of Peggy's piglets.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: While chasing her piglet Porkchop, Gaby accidentally jumped into the swimming pool not realizing she was still wearing her lapel microphone. As the lapel mic was broken beyond repair, she had to share with Donald's own microphone.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Big Brother furthered Gaby's punishment by spending the night the piglet pen and communicate with the housemates using semaphore flags, as suggested by Jon. Donald, being the cause of her further violations, later decided to join her so her punishment would be less harsh for her. Her punishment ended the next day.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Ethel visited the House in the wee hours of the morning and talked with Big Brother. Citing the changes among the people she knew and having missed the housemates, she expressed her willingness to return. Big Brother told her that he would think it over, especially her time spent in the House the first time. His decision, he told her, would be known in the "appointed time." Later in the evening, Ruben finally made his long delayed marriage proposal to his partner, the mother of his three children, who responded by telling him that she would think it over. Much later, Mariel, having missed the housemates, accepted Big Brother's invitation to be in the House once again.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Gladys told Big Sister (Mariel) her intention to leave, even deciding not to participate in "Olym-pigs." Big Sister, on a loss of what to do, told Gladys to hold on until Big Brother's return. But the advice only made Gladys's plea to let her make her exit stronger. Meanwhile, Ruben personally reiterated his proposal to his partner; this time it was accepted. The acceptance was shown to the others two weeks later.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Gladys left the house after slipping into depression for the last two days. In contrast, Big Sister convinced Gaby to stay. The latter already mentioned to Big Brother plans for a second voluntary exit days before.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Ethel emerged from the confession room together with Jan and Vier. Mariel and the housemates gathered around to welcome her back.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: During a cocktail "beach party," Baron became intoxicated, flirting with several female housemates and unintentionally insulting Big Brother. He was accompanied by the other male housemates in the secret room to help him sober up.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Popular character Barney T. Dinosaur visited the housemates and danced with them for a short time.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: The housemates sold their paintings of their piglets to raise P20,000 for charity. This was made as an alternative to selling their piglets to siblings "Lydia," "Tomas," and "Mila" (names associated with the roasted pig business) in exchange for the same amount. Later, noted plastic surgeon and beauty specialist Vicki Belo visited the housemates. She gave them advice on skin care. The housemates were also treated to a full body treatment by workers of her clinic.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: After burying her mother, Yayo expressed her decision to return to the House, creating a complicated situation with only two weeks left in the show's extended run. Endemol created four conditions for Yayo's return, one of the first three being that one of the six Housemates still in the House should voluntarily surrender his/her stint. Gaby readily stated her intention to end her second stint.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Big Brother signaled the end of the Season-Long Task and instructed the housemates to say goodbye to their piglets, who would rejoin their mother at a zoo/animal farm in Tagaytay. Later, Yayo was allowed to leave the secret room and be with the housemates once again.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: The housemate had their Christmas Eve dinner. They agreed to exchange their menu for their dinner with food prepared by a poor community for their dinner.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: In the wee hours, Baron broke a promise he made to Big Brother when he once again became drunk and made offensive gestures in the process. In the morning, Zara, Megan, Victor, Jen, Marylaine, Donald, and Mcoy each visited the remaining housemates for a hundred seconds to personally greet them Merry Christmas. Later, Ruben had his Christmas gift: witnessing his mother, her sister, and her mother reunited inside the House for the first time since even before he was born.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Baron was told that he had been forced out the House as a consequence of his second drunken stupor during the wee hours of Christmas which resulted in various violations, unintentional insults to Big Brother, and later, Gaby's ire. Donald returned to the House to fetch him.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Ruben and his partner were finally married at a nearby church. Later, Mariel and Ethel made their final exits. In the first of two tests set by Big Brother shortly afterwards, none of the five willed to answer which of them does not deserve to be in the "Big Four." In the second test, Ruben was unanimously voted by the others as the one deserving to be the "Big Winner" of the second Celebrity Edition.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Somehow pressured by the various signals and videos about what they did the night before and Big Brother's unwillingness to talk, the five housemates decided to answer which of them do not deserve to be in the "Big Four." But all five gained the X-medals, forcing Jon to "nominate" the two females for eviction. Unfortunately, a remark by Jon before nominations implied that something was afoot and their problems with Big Brother did not end at the moment of the "live nomination."

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Jon finally admitted to that his remark somehow influenced the voting the night before. In fact, to seemingly support this, Ruben and Gaby confessed that it was not their intention to nominate their selections (Ruben chose Will; Gaby chose Ruben) rather than Riza. Big Brother reminded the five of following rules, but decided to hold out Jon's consequence to a later time in order not to spoil the revelry of New Year's Eve.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: As consulted by Endemol, it was decided that regardless of his standing in the open voting, Jon would be given the forced eviction because of his violation of rules due to the implied influence of his remark during the "nomination" round three days before.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Bianca, together with several actors from the upcoming show Kung Fu Kids, entered the House to interview the "Big Four." It was only during the course of the interview that she had found out that she became a house guest.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: After some talk with the housemates and helping them with their coin tower, Bianca was told that she could leave. Immediately after her departure, she hosted the last episode of Über for the season.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: The finale in this edition, held on January 5, 2008, at the Araneta Coliseum was dubbed "The Big Night at the Big Dome." It had a Hollywood awards night theme.

videos.title: Episode 1 - The Big Collab
videos.overview: As ABS-CBN and GMA join forces to create a bigger constellation of stars, the PBB House reopens its doors to welcome both Kapamilya and Kapuso celebrities. However, before stepping inside, the celebrity housemates must first complete a crucial task.

videos.title: Episode 2 - Collab Of Stars
videos.overview: With their freedom at stake, PBB hosts Melai Cantiveros-Francisco, Gabbi Garcia, Mavy Legazpi, and Alexa Ilacad give their all to complete Kuya's special task, which holds the keys to breaking the barrier between the Kapamilya and Kapuso housemates.

videos.title: Episode 3 - Firsts
videos.overview: Big Brother officially welcomes the Kapamilya and Kapuso celebrities, including his newest houseguest, who leads the task of getting to know the housemates' stories.

videos.title: Episode 4 - Twist
videos.overview: The celebrity housemates' emotional heart-to-heart conversations continue. Later, Big Brother announces a major twist regarding the collaboration between the Kapamilya and the Kapuso stars.

videos.title: Episode 5 - Duo
videos.overview: The housemates select partners who will be their allies during their stay in the PBB House. While taking on their first weekly task, Big Brother approves Kira Balinger’s plan to surprise Josh on his birthday—but with one condition.

videos.title: Episode 6 - Party Parting
videos.overview: During his birthday celebration, Josh struggles to shake off the painful memories of the tragic accident that claimed his friends' lives. After the festivities, emotions run high as the housemates bid farewell to one of their companions.

videos.title: Episode 7 - Thank you Ivana
videos.overview: Charlie gets emotional when a fellow housemate calls her out. The housemates push through the final leg of their first weekly task. After sharing her parting gifts, Ivana Alawi braces herself to leave the PBB House and return to the outside world.

videos.title: Episode 8 - Jowa O Tropa
videos.overview: Tension rises in the PBB house after a mix-up in the division of chores sparks a misunderstanding. Some housemates take on the "Jojowain o Totropahin" challenge as AZ opens up about her dream. Emotions run high when Ivana finally reveals the truth.

videos.title: Episode 9 - Punishment
videos.overview: The housemates grow anxious upon noticing that their portraits in the living room have been covered with sealed envelopes. Their suspicions are soon confirmed when Big Brother punishes them for breaking his house rules.

videos.title: Episode 10 - Housemate Reveal
videos.overview: The teamwork of the Kapamilya celebrities is put to the test in a task that would give a special advantage to a Kapuso star. Soon, Big Brother's newest housemate is introduced.

videos.title: Episode 11 - New Duos
videos.overview: With new partnerships in place, AC Bonifacio and Ashley Ortega set things straight with each other. The Kapamilya and the Kapuso celebrities brim with excitement upon getting an announcement about the arrival of a new housemate.

videos.title: Episode 12 - Classmates
videos.overview: After Balong, Esnyr's other characters step into the house and share moments with the housemates. While portraying Precious, he gets called to the confession room to welcome Big Brother's newest housemate.

videos.title: Episode 13 - New Housemate
videos.overview: The housemates take on their second weekly task, inspired by Esnyr's beloved characters. A story from the outside world unfolds when AC decides to talk to Bianca about an unresolved issue between them.

videos.title: Episode 14 - One Shot Film
videos.overview: Tensions rise among the housemates as misunderstandings surface while they race against time to prepare for their second weekly task. A new face makes a surprise entrance into the PBB house.

videos.title: Episode 15 - 1st Nomi
videos.overview: River gets emotional, blaming himself for their second weekly task's failure. Gabbi receives a special mission upon entering the PBB House. The housemates anxiously await the results of their first nomination night.

videos.title: Episode 16 - Nomi Duos
videos.overview: A somber atmosphere fills the PBB House as the housemates, especially the nominated duos, struggle to come to terms with the results of their 1st Nomination Night. Gabbi receives a task that aims to help the housemates connect more with each other.

videos.title: Episode 17 - Big Boys
videos.overview: Days before the opening of their Pinoy Big Pares, the boys transform into waiters to show off their amazing customer service skills, eliciting cheers and joyful screams from the female housemates.

videos.title: Episode 18 - Big Girls
videos.overview: The Pinoy Big Boys continue to serve kilig vibes as they participate in a pageant. To help them better connect with their loved ones, Gabbi hosts a special dining experience for the nominated housemates.

videos.title: Episode 19 - Be My Guest
videos.overview: Emotions run high in the PBB House as the rest of the nominated housemates take a seat for a heartfelt dinner. Led by Esnyr and Bianca, the housemates come together to host a farewell party for Gabbi.

videos.title: Episode 20 - Kim-Pau-Res
videos.overview: Before bidding farewell to the PBB House, Gabbi shares a memorable night with the housemates, leaving heartfelt words to her new friends. Kim Chiu and Paulo Avelino step inside the house as Pinoy Big Pares opens.

videos.title: Episode 21 - 1st Duo Eviction
videos.overview: Pinoy Big Pares continues to serve its specialties as it strives to reach its goal. Tension rises in the PBB House as the housemates prepare for the season's first eviction. Adding to the excitement, a Kapuso queen makes a grand entrance.

videos.title: Episode 22 - Crown
videos.overview: Following the first eviction night, Michelle Marquez Dee receives a warm welcome as she steps into the PBB House. Two new housemates bid farewell to the outside world and embark on their journey inside Kuya's home.

videos.title: Episode 23 - 3rd New Duos
videos.overview: After warmly welcoming Michelle Dee, the housemates face the tough challenge of selecting new partners. Emilio Daez and Vince Maristela are set to make their grand entrance into the PBB House.

videos.title: Episode 24 - BlonDeeVa
videos.overview: Big Brother thinks of an exciting way to introduce Emilio and Vince to the housemates. Michelle receives a special task to help the celebrities show their true selves to the public.

videos.title: Episode 25 - Sharing
videos.overview: As the housemates continue to share the public's misconceptions about them, Klarisse experiences a great sense of freedom upon seizing the opportunity to make a big revelation.

videos.title: Episode 26 - Connections
videos.overview: As Dustin gradually reveals his growing interest in Bianca, Will attempts to reconnect with his former co-star. Big Brother assigns the housemates their fourth weekly task—successfully organizing a fashion show showcasing their own designs.

videos.title: Episode 27 - Flags
videos.overview: Mika's sincerity comes under scrutiny as some housemates suspect she is keeping her true feelings hidden. Big Brother challenges the housemates to rate each other based on authenticity.

videos.title: Episode 28 - Rampa Apmar
videos.overview: Big Brother asks Klarisse to complete the song she composed for their one-shot film. After bidding an emotional farewell to Michelle Dee, the housemates confidently hit the runway as they take on their fourth weekly task.

videos.title: Episode 29 - 2nd Nomi Duos
videos.overview: After the fashion show, Big Brother reveals the results of the fourth weekly task. AZ sincerely apologizes to Mika for jumping to conclusions about her. The housemates prepare for what is to come as a new set of nominees is revealed.

videos.title: Episode 30 - Sanya All
videos.overview: The boy housemates put their best foot forward as Kapuso star Sanya Lopez enters the house as the searcher in a pool dating game. The newly nominated duos try to keep their emotions in check as they face the looming threat of eviction.

videos.title: Episode 31 - Boys Night Out
videos.overview: While the ladies are busy practicing for their secret task, the boys enjoy a special night out and make candid revelations about their feelings for the girl housemates. Soon, the latest houseguest is introduced.

videos.title: Episode 32 - Oppa
videos.overview: Fresh from the boys’ night out, Will musters up the courage to tell Bianca how he feels for her. The girls soon unleash their inner P-pop stars as they officially welcome Kim Ji-soo.

videos.title: Episode 33 - Ji Soo Life
videos.overview: After enjoying a fun game with the housemates, Kim Ji-soo showcases his acting skills in a skit with Esnyr. A new weekly task challenges the housemates’ teamwork and coordination. In a heartfelt moment, Kira opens up to Big Brother about her parents.

videos.title: Episode 34 - PDrama
videos.overview: With Ji-soo lending his Tagalog skills, the housemates take on a special PDrama challenge that not only puts their acting abilities to the test but also gives them a chance to lighten the load of their demanding weekly task.

videos.title: Episode 35 - 2nd Duo Eviction
videos.overview: Before returning to the outside world, Ji-soo treats the housemates to a special Korean meal. Some housemates open up about how their weekly task mirrors their real-life experiences. One of the three nominated duos prepares to exit the PBB House.

videos.title: Episode 36 - Lover's Quarell
videos.overview: Dustin voices his disappointment over the boys' previous teasing. Following their weekly task, the housemates grapple with sadness after another duo’s eviction. Two new faces prepare to step into the PBB House.

videos.title: Episode 37 - Presscon
videos.overview: Big Brother hosts a press conference for Xyriel Manabat and Shuvee Etrata to help the housemates learn more about their newest companions. As a new week begins, the housemates pair up with new partners.

videos.title: Episode 38 - Stop Bashing
videos.overview: The housemates turn emotional as they open up about the hurtful comments they often receive from the public. Tension brews when Vince gets offended by jokes about him.

videos.title: Episode 39 - Bloom
videos.overview: As the housemates' sixth weekly task requires them to be silent, the Kapamilya and the Kapuso celebrities struggle to contain their excitement about the possible arrival of some blooming houseguests.

videos.title: Episode 40 - 3rd Nomi Duos
videos.overview: Amid their weekly task, the housemates struggle to contain their surprise as BINI Stacey and Jhoanna drop by unexpectedly. A misunderstanding stirs tension in the house. Three duos face nomination this week.

videos.title: Episode 41 - Face-off
videos.overview: The housemates, especially the nominated duos, struggle to keep their emotions in check after the third nomination night. Klarisse loses her temper as she and Dustin try to clear the air between them.

videos.title: Episode 42 - Tension
videos.overview: Tension lingers as Klarisse and Dustin struggle to overcome their misunderstanding. Later, BINI Jhoanna and Stacey lead the housemates in raising awareness about the importance of sign language through a special performance.

videos.title: Episode 43 - BINI JhoCey
videos.overview: Big Brother tasks Esnyr and Will to organize a memorable send-off party for BINI Jhoanna and Stacey as their stay inside the house ends. Meanwhile, the lovely guests prepare a parting gift for the housemates.

videos.title: Episode 44 - Bottle Theories
videos.overview: Klarisse and Dustin mend fences after clearing up their misunderstanding. However, tension resurfaces as bottles revealing the reasons behind each nomination point are unveiled in the living area.

videos.title: Episode 45 - Saing Kings
videos.overview: Michael and Emilio read the bottles revealing the reasons behind their nomination points. Emilio and Ralph face off in a rap battle about rice cooking. A new weekly task tests the housemates' patience and determination.

videos.title: Episode 46 - 3rd Duo Eviction
videos.overview: Task leaders Vince and Emilio make a tough call for their weekly task. Emotions run high as another duo prepares to leave the PBB House on the third eviction night.

videos.title: Episode 47 - Violations
videos.overview: While teaching Shuvee a valuable lesson, Big Brother punishes the housemates for their repeated violations. The mood turns somber after eviction night. A special messenger later arrives at the PBB House.

videos.title: Episode 48 - Messenger
videos.overview: The housemates take on a new duo formation task for a chance to choose their next partner. Excitement fills the air as Donny Pangilinan steps into the house to deliver special presents from the outside world.

videos.title: Episode 49 - Letters
videos.overview: The housemates meet their newest house guest, much to Shuvee's excitement. Big Brother later gives them their 8th weekly task, which is also connected to the letters they received from the outside world.

videos.title: Episode 50 - Donny Advice
videos.overview: AZ breaks down in tears upon reading her letter. As they continue their weekly task, the housemates work together to score the necessary points to help Shuvee obtain her father's message for her.

videos.title: Episode 51 - Game Night
videos.overview: Will and Josh grow emotional as they read heartfelt letters from their loved ones. To ease the heavy mood, the housemates enjoy a lighthearted game night hosted by Donny.

videos.title: Episode 52 - Night Out
videos.overview: The celebration inside the PBB house escalates as the housemates take shots while playing Donny’s game. As the drinks take effect, they end up looking after one another in their intoxicated state.

videos.title: Episode 53 - After Party
videos.overview: Despite their hangover, the housemates push through and give their best to hit their target points in their weekly task. Soon, they grow emotional as they share heartfelt stories while reading letters from their loved ones.

videos.title: Episode 54 - 4th Nomi Duos
videos.overview: The housemates prepare a heartfelt surprise for Donny. After Big Brother hands an automatic nomination to one housemate, two other duos brace for possible eviction. A Kapuso celebrity makes a special entrance into the house.

videos.title: Episode 55 - Fetch Donny
videos.overview: AZ makes a difficult decision after reading a letter from the outside world. Donny bids farewell to the PBB house after receiving a heartfelt gift from the housemates.

videos.title: Episode 56 - Mr. David
videos.overview: A mix of emotions fills the house following the nomination night. River tries to make a sacrifice for a nominated housemate, while Klarisse feels guilty for putting Shuvee in a difficult position. Big Brother gives his new guest a secret task.

videos.title: Episode 57 - Secret Picture
videos.overview: The three nominated duos act in utmost secrecy upon receiving their weekly task that involves taking pictures of their fellow housemates without them knowing. Meanwhile, David advises Dustin about his situation with Bianca.

videos.title: Episode 58 - Furwell
videos.overview: After completing the first part of their secret weekly task, Xyriel and Ralph speak to Dustin and Bianca separately about their relationship. Soon after, Bianca receives heartbreaking news from the outside world.

videos.title: Episode 59 - Sneak Pics
videos.overview: As part of the nominated housemates' secret weekly task, Xyriel draws on her acting experience to move Mika to tears, giving Shuvee a chance to capture the moment. The challenge intensifies when they must photograph an annoyed River.

videos.title: Episode 60 - 4th Duo Eviction
videos.overview: River gets caught in the middle of Xyriel and Shuvee’s argument, unaware that it is part of the nominated housemates’ secret weekly task. Another duo prepares to exit the PBB house.

videos.title: Episode 61 - Wild News
videos.overview: Big Brother reveals the result of the nominated housemates' secret weekly task, prompting Shuvee to apologize to River. David exits the PBB house. A shocking piece of news stirs the viewers.

videos.title: Episode 62 - New Duos
videos.overview: Following an emotional eviction night, the housemates compete against each other in another duo formation task. Later, Big Brother reveals their 10th weekly task.

videos.title: Episode 63 - Golden Seats
videos.overview: In preparation for their weekly task, the housemates try their hands at various carnival acts. Soon, two special house guests host a game show that will give the housemates a chance to see their loved ones at the Big Carnival concert.

videos.title: Episode 64 - DongCha
videos.overview: Hoping to see their loved ones, the housemates try to garner points as Charo Santos-Concio and Dingdong Dantes test their knowledge about their mothers. Bianca and River secretly accomplish a secret task for Dustin's birthday.

videos.title: Episode 65 - 2nd Golden Seat Game
videos.overview: The housemates face off as they vie for the privilege of seeing their loved ones at the Big Carnival concert, unaware of the tough decision waiting for the winning team.

videos.title: Episode 66 - The Big Carnival Concert
videos.overview: After days of preparation for the Big Carnival concert, the housemates finally perform several circus acts in front of a live audience and some of their loved ones.

videos.title: Episode 67 - The Big Comeback
videos.overview: Before the second run of the Big Carnival concert, Mika calls Brent to the confession room while she shares a moment with her mom. Two eliminated housemates make a big comeback.

videos.title: Episode 68 - Big Hide 'N Seek
videos.overview: Following his big comeback, Ralph finds himself playing an intense hide-and-seek as the boy housemates conceal him from the girls as part of their eleventh weekly task.

videos.title: Episode 69 - Sneak
videos.overview: Charlie returns to the PBB house as the other eliminated housemate the boys must hide from the girls to accomplish their weekly task. With this, the male housemates strategize to keep her and Ralph hidden.

videos.title: Episode 70 - Final Duo Medals
videos.overview: With the girls' sharp eyes and intuition, the boys struggle to hide Charlie and Ralph. Big Brother reveals a shocking twist regarding the housemates' final duo formation.

videos.title: Episode 71 - 1st Big Intensity Task
videos.overview: Brent and Vince become Charlie and Ralph's special messengers. Pressure mounts for the Kapuso housemates as they compete against each other in their first Big Intensity Task.

videos.title: Episode 72 - Final Duo Medal
videos.overview: After the Kapuso housemates take their turn, the Kapamilya housemates race to answer a series of questions in their first Big Intensity Task as they compete for the Final Duo Medal.

videos.title: Episode 73 - 2nd Big Intensity Task
videos.overview: The boy housemates face Big Brother's challenge as they try to accomplish their weekly task. The second Big Intensity Task begins, putting the remaining housemates' relationships to the test.

videos.title: Episode 74 - Big Intensity Challenge 2
videos.overview: The housemates struggle to hold back their emotions as the second Big Intensity Challenge pushes them to deduct points from their opponents in order to gain immunity and secure a Final Duo Medal.

videos.title: Episode 75 - BSita / Visit
videos.overview: After the second Big Intensity Challenge, the housemates notice the sudden absence of Ralph, Shuvee, AZ, and Esnyr. Kapuso artist and "Encantadia Chronicles: Sang’gre" star Bianca Umali shares a touching story before entering the PBB house.

videos.title: Episode 76 - Money Roll Task
videos.overview: With Bianca Umali's help, the housemates put their coordination to the test in a challenge that could support Ralph, Shuvee, Esnyr, and AZ during their stay in the secret room.

videos.title: Episode 77 - Secret Room Budget
videos.overview: Bianca Umali and the nominated housemates work tirelessly to earn enough budget for Shuvee, Esnyr, AZ, and Ralph. Later, Big Brother levels up their task with a major switch.

videos.title: Episode 78 - AnJaneNaSiya
videos.overview: Kapamilya actress Jane de Leon arrives at the PBB house and meets the housemates. As her stay comes to an end, Kapuso star Bianca Umali receives a special farewell gift from Big Brother.

videos.title: Episode 79 - Back To The House Task
videos.overview: To secure additional budget, the nominated housemates make use of their unique talents. With Jane's help, Shuvee, Esnyr, AZ, and Ralph take on a difficult task to reunite with their friends in the secret room.

videos.title: Episode 80 - 5th Eviction Night
videos.overview: Despite their struggles and Big Brother's surprises, AZ, Shuvee, Ralph, and Esnyr successfully complete their Balik Bahay Task with Jane's help. Later, two housemates exit the PBB house.

videos.title: Episode 81 - Thank You Jane
videos.overview: Big Brother calls several housemates to the confession room after they enjoy the delicious meal prepared by Jane de Leon. Following their special guest’s departure, tears flow inside the PBB house after the eviction night.

videos.title: Episode 82 - White Box
videos.overview: After receiving their final duo medals, the housemates begin ranking one another as they take on the first phase of their last duo formation challenge.

videos.title: Episode 83 - Ranking
videos.overview: Following the preliminary ranking, Big Brother sends a white box revealing the Kapuso and Kapamilya housemates voted as the least desirable final duo partners.

videos.title: Episode 84 - Final Duo Formation Task
videos.overview: Driven to prove themselves worthy, the housemates push their memorization and balancing skills to the limit as they compete in their Final Duo Formation Task.

videos.title: Episode 85 - Final Duo Day 1
videos.overview: While Ralph earns the privilege of picking his final duo partner after finishing first in their Final Duo Formation task, Big Brother announces a twist in the duo selection process. Later, the first final duo is revealed.

videos.title: Episode 86 - Final Duo Day 2
videos.overview: Big Brother grants Shuvee's earnest request for a barbecue party to celebrate her birthday and later gives her a special gift. Four other housemates make their choice for their final duo partner.

videos.title: Episode 87 - Final Duo Day 3
videos.overview: For their weekly task, the housemates create personal logos that they must surprisingly incorporate into their floor dance choreography. Later, the last batch of final duos is unveiled.

videos.title: Episode 88 - Face to Face Nomination
videos.overview: Following the formation of the final six duos, the housemates steel themselves as they explain the reasons behind each point they give during a face-to-face nomination.

videos.title: Episode 89 - Thoughts and Feelings
videos.overview: As the housemates grapple with the hurt and guilt brought on by the face-to-face nomination, Bianca opens up about the pain of receiving three points from someone she deeply trusts, Mika.

videos.title: Episode 90 - Heart To Heart
videos.overview: Before the day ends, Ralph approaches AZ to apologize for his words during the face-to-face nomination. As the housemates paint to represent the charities they want to support, Heart Evangelista enters the PBB house.

videos.title: Episode 91 - Hi Barbie
videos.overview: The boy housemates rise to Big Brother’s challenge to make Heart Evangelista’s short stay at the PBB house unforgettable. Soon after, a new house guest arrives to surprise everyone.

videos.title: Episode 92 - Charity Task
videos.overview: The six final duos compete in a ball-stacking challenge in a bid to win the 100,000-peso prize for their chosen charities. A former housemate returns to PBB as the newest house guest.

videos.title: Episode 93 - 6th Duo Eviction
videos.overview: Gerald Anderson lends a hand as the housemates complete the first part of their weekly task to raise funds for their chosen charities. Mika and Bianca decide to bury the hatchet. Another duo returns to the outside world.

videos.title: Episode 94 - MariSunshine
videos.overview: Before the sixth eviction night, a former PBB housemate makes a long-awaited return after more than a decade. The housemates are overcome with emotion as another duo bids farewell and returns to the outside world.

videos.title: Episode 95 - Duo Challengers
videos.overview: The housemates try to move forward following the heartbreaking sixth eviction night. Ten evicted housemates return to the PBB house as duo challengers to test Big Brother's final five duos.

videos.title: Episode 96 - Challenger Visit
videos.overview: After the other house challengers take their turn, Klarisse and Shuvee are overcome with emotion as they reunite with their friends inside the PBB house. Shortly after, the housemates receive their 15th weekly task, which involves the evictees.

videos.title: Episode 97 - Duo Match
videos.overview: After ranking themselves from the strongest to weakest, the final five duos unleash their competitive sides and employ their balancing skills to win against the house challengers in the first round of matchups.

videos.title: Episode 98 - Big Face-Off
videos.overview: After winning all five matchups, the housemates face a challenging question from Big Brother. Later, Charlie and Esnyr find themselves in the hot seat as they defend their spots and prove their worth to the duo challengers in a debate.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Tension fills the room as the duo challengers grill teams DusBi, RaWi, and AZVer with difficult and personal questions to test their character and determine whether they deserve a spot in the Big 4.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: Brent and Mika stand their ground as the duo challengers attempt to rattle them during a tense interview. Later, the housemates and the evictees cast their votes for the duo they believe deserves a spot in the Big Night.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: As the first Big Jump challenge begins, teams RaWi, BreKa, DusBi, and AZVer race against each other to complete a puzzle. Soon, a duo successfully claims the second spot in the Big 4.

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: ChaRes receives a surprise visit from their loved ones, who bring their favorite food to share with the other housemates. Later, Esnyr seizes the opportunity to have a heart-to-heart talk with his father.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: Ralph and Will find strength and motivation as their loved ones drop by the PBB house. The housemates later receive their 16th weekly task, which requires the help of their special guests. The second Big Jump challenge begins.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: Teams BreKa, DusBi, and AZVer push their limits and use all their strength to hold the letter blocks and win in their Big Jump challenge. After several grueling hours, one duo successfully secures their coveted spot in the Big 4.

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: River and AZ share a touching moment with their mothers as they drop by the house to give them support ahead of the Big Night. Teams BreKa and DusBi face off in the final Big Jump challenge, resulting in one duo earning the last spot in the Big 4.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: Before this season's final eviction, Dustin, Bianca, Brent, and Mika grow emotional as their parents visit to offer words of encouragement. The housemates are caught off guard when Vice Ganda makes a surprise entrance into the PBB house.

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Facing the most intriguing and candid questions, the Big 4 duos bare their truest thoughts and feelings as they speak with Asia's King of Talk Boy Abunda in a no-holds-barred interview.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: During an intense interview with the Asia's King of Talk, the Big 4 Duos defend themselves against the outside world's differing perceptions about them. Soon, the housemates face a new challenge that could help them earn votes for the Big Night.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: The Big 4 Duos make every effort to ace their first 1 Million Vote Challenge. While BreKa and AZVer figure out the perfect strategy to balance their seesaws, CharEs and RaWi struggle to find their own.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: As their second 1 Million Challenge begins, the Big 4 Duos fight with unwavering determination to obtain additional votes and the ten comments about them from the outside world. Later, the housemates celebrate the end of their PBB journey.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: As this historic season concludes, "Pinoy Big Brother" looks back on the Big 4 Duos' eventful journey inside the house. Soon, one duo earns the most votes and becomes the first-ever Big Winner Duo.

videos.title: Episode 1 - 2point0
videos.overview: Big Brother opens his house again to a new batch of housemates—20 rising Gen Z stars from ABS-CBN's Star Magic and GMA's Sparkle Artist Center. Upon stepping into the iconic Bahay ni Kuya, the housemates receive their first-ever task letter.

videos.title: Episode 2 - First Night
videos.overview: The celebrity housemates bond as they spend their first night together in the PBB House. Later, their teamwork is tested as they face their very first task.

videos.title: Episode 3 - Be Scared
videos.overview: The celebrity teen housemates divide the household chores on their first morning inside the PBB House. Later, screams and shouts echo through the iconic yellow house with the arrival of a spooky guest.

videos.title: Episode 4 - Ghost Of Life
videos.overview: After retrieving mysterious scrolls with the help of their eerie visitor, the housemates grow emotional as they confront their ghosts and open up about the lowest points in their lives.

videos.title: Episode 5 - Face Ur Ghost
videos.overview: The boys embrace their feminine side after the girls give them a glam makeover. Emotions run high in the PBB House as the housemates continue to open up about their most heartbreaking experiences.

videos.title: Episode 6 - Candelabra
videos.overview: Tension rises in the PBB House as the housemates plan their strategy for their first ever weekly task, where they must carry and balance a massive candelabra while keeping its flames burning.

videos.title: Episode 7 - CandLevelUp
videos.overview: While the celebrity teen housemates struggle with their first weekly task, Big Brother levels up the challenge through a dance routine. Later, the task leaders' choices on who gets to assist become a hot topic among the housemates.

videos.title: Episode 8 - LastCandle
videos.overview: The celebrity housemates bring their game face to the table in a bid to win as Big Brother levels up their Kandelabra de Horror task anew. While discussing their weekly budget, the teens address the issue of leftovers.

videos.title: Episode 9 - EsnyrYall
videos.overview: Big Brother delivers a game-changing announcement that leaves the housemates reflecting on their fate. After changing into school uniforms, they are stunned when Esnyr Ranollo makes a surprise return to the PBB House.

videos.title: Episode 10 - FirstGroupings
videos.overview: After team leaders Anton, Krystal, Carmelle, Reich, and Miguel select the members of their respective groups, Big Brother announces major changes that will impact the housemates’ journey inside the PBB House.

videos.title: Episode 11 - Punishment
videos.overview: Determined to teach an important lesson, Big Brother gives the housemates report cards listing their violations, then makes them carry the consequences of breaking the house rules.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Lee admits he regrets raising his voice during Big Brother’s punishment. The housemates share heartwarming and emotional stories about their families as they take on their second weekly task.

videos.title: Episode 13 - Cleaners
videos.overview: The groups present the stories behind the dioramas they created. As Big Brother takes steps to maintain the house’s cleanliness, Iñigo voices his frustration over the housemates’ lack of initiative and discipline.

videos.title: Episode 14 - Songerists
videos.overview: Fred, Heath, Caprice, and Sofia receive their reward for taking charge of the house's cleanliness. Music fills the house as Big Brother tasks Heath and Carmelle with forming two groups to create their own versions of "Kabataang Pinoy."

videos.title: Episode 15 - Tower
videos.overview: As part of their second weekly task, the celebrity teen housemates find ways to build a sturdy five-level tower with their dioramas. Eliza and Miguel talk about their once-blossoming friendship.

videos.title: Episode 16 - FirstNomi
videos.overview: Before casting their group judgments on the first nomination night, the housemates face off in a time-to-beat Ligtask Challenge, hoping to secure immunity and avoid eviction.

videos.title: Episode 17 - Weight
videos.overview: The housemates try their best to comfort Rays of Sunshine members Reich, Waynona, Fred, and Princess after they become the season’s first batch of nominees.

videos.title: Episode 18 - MeetAndGreet
videos.overview: The housemates enjoy a special meet-and-greet as Piolo Pascual and Joshua Garcia enter the PBB House to serve as team captains for a task tied to their upcoming movie.

videos.title: Episode 19 - PhotoCake
videos.overview: Taking on Big Brother’s special challenge, Caprice makes a heartfelt sacrifice connected to her most meaningful life experiences as she celebrates her special day inside the PBB House.

videos.title: Episode 20 - Confession
videos.overview: Big Brother appoints Heath, Lella, and Anton as leaders for the third weekly task. Carmelle and Krystal offer Eliza valuable advice as both Miguel and Marco start showing interest in her.

videos.title: Episode 21 - Reward
videos.overview: The boys serenade the girls with an original composition. Big Brother gives the nominated Rays of Sunshine members a special task for an opportunity to bond with their fellow housemates.

videos.title: Episode 22 - FirstEviction
videos.overview: Big Brother gives Eliza some advice as she weighs her complicated feelings for both Miguel and Marco. Later, two nominated housemates bid farewell to the PBB house.

videos.title: Episode 23 - Battle
videos.overview: The housemates prove they have what it takes to become action stars as they strive to win their weekly task. Emotions run high in the PBB House following the season’s first eviction.

videos.title: Episode 24 - Second Groupings
videos.overview: The housemates begin to feel the holiday spirit as they hang their personalized decorations on the Christmas tree. Soon after, they take on another task for the second group formation.

videos.title: Episode 25 - Dear Young Me
videos.overview: Following the second group formation, Big Brother reveals that the winning group in the Ligtask challenge will be given a heavy responsibility. The housemates get emotional as they read the touching letters they wrote for their younger selves.

videos.title: Episode 26 - Balagtasan
videos.overview: Tears continue to flow in the PBB House as the housemates open their hearts to their younger selves through the moving letters they wrote. Afterwards, each group delivers their sharpest verses as they face off in a traditional Filipino poetic debate.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Pressure creeps in for the celebrity teen housemates as the first leg of their Ligtask Challenge begins. While the Determined Warriors struggle to score points, the Smiling Angels and the Strong-Willed Fighters go head-to-head.

videos.title: Episode 28 - Confused
videos.overview: As the second part of their Ligtask Challenge begins, the Smiling Angels manage to secure a lead over the Strong-willed Fighters and the Determined Warriors. Eliza and Miguel talk about the real score between them.

videos.title: Episode 29 - Meet Greet Belle
videos.overview: As the housemates continue with their weekly task, Belle Mariano attempts to slip into the PBB House unnoticed with the covert help of task leaders Princess, Eliza, Ashley, and the rest of the girls.

videos.title: Episode 30 - Second Nomi
videos.overview: The fight for immunity intensifies as the celebrity housemates go up against each other in the third and last part of this week's Ligtask Challenge. Soon, tension fills the house as the victorious Smiling Angels decide on the nominated group.

videos.title: Episode 31  - Console
videos.overview: Following the tense-filled nomination, the housemates rush to comfort their Determined Warriors friends, who are slowly coming to terms with their uncertain fate.

videos.title: Episode 32 - Network
videos.overview: As Big Brother gives them a chance to prove themselves through a special weekly task, nominated housemates Eliza, Carmelle, Krystal, Marco, Heath, and Anton waste no time preparing six live shows that will showcase their stories.

videos.title: Episode 33 - Kuya Ruru
videos.overview: Kapuso actor Ruru Madrid brings excitement and valuable insights as a house guest in the PBB House. Later, the housemates work together to obtain a special gift for their nominated friends.

videos.title: Episode 34 - Day 1 Live Shows
videos.overview: The nominated housemates turn emotional upon receiving their special reward—a message of support from their loved ones. With their friends' help, Carmelle and Anton showcase their creativity as their live shows begin.

videos.title: Episode 35 - Thanks Ruru
videos.overview: To show gratitude to their house guest, the housemates prepare a heartfelt birthday surprise for Ruru Madrid. On the second day of their live shows, Krystal and Marco try to captivate the viewers with their inspiring life stories.

videos.title: Episode 36 - Second Eviction
videos.overview: As their weekly task continues, Heath and Eliza bare their true selves during their live shows. Soon, tears are shed following the eviction of two housemates.

videos.title: Episode 37 - Code Names
videos.overview: A new ship sets sail inside the PBB house. Later, tensions rise after Big Brother calls out a teen housemate for their frequent use of codes and code names.

videos.title: Episode 38 - Violators
videos.overview: New groups emerge as the housemates take on a simple yet challenging leader task, only to be met with unexpected disciplinary action from Big Brother following their recent violations.

videos.title: Episode 39 - Small Room
videos.overview: As they remain locked up in separate prison cells, the housemates begin to suffer the consequences of their violations and lack of discipline as they face Big Brother’s punishment.

videos.title: Episode 40 - Lesson Learned
videos.overview: The violators continue to suffer the consequences of their actions as they return to their prison cells. Realizing they have broken Big Brother’s trust, the housemates enter the confession room to admit their mistakes and apologize.

videos.title: Episode 41 - Consequence
videos.overview: While serving Big Brother’s punishment, the housemates take on their sixth weekly task, which directly corresponds to the number of violations they committed.

videos.title: Episode 42 - Love You So Bad
videos.overview: Former celebrity housemates Bianca de Vera, Will Ashley, and Dustin Yu return as House Inspectors to evaluate the house’s cleanliness. Later, the “Love You So Bad” stars get to lend the housemates a hand with their sixth weekly task.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: The housemates notice the growing closeness between Princess and Fred. After a careless teen commits the same violation again, a furious Big Brother raises the difficulty of the weekly task. Soon, tension fills the PBB house.

videos.title: Episode 44 - Third Nomi
videos.overview: Following the tensions from the weekly task and their ongoing punishment, the housemates carefully weigh their choices as they face a difficult decision in the third nomination night.

videos.title: Episode 45 - Shuvee On Duty
videos.overview: Following Big Brother's shocking directive, Shuvee Etrata returns to ensure that the housemates comply. As their houseguest tries to make sense of the situation, the girls fill her in on their unresolved issue with the guys.

videos.title: Episode 46 - Bakit List
videos.overview: Realizing their mistakes, the boys discuss the best ways to address the issues the girls raised about their inappropriate jokes. To help the housemates meet in the middle, Shuvee hosts a talk show where they can bridge the gap between them.

videos.title: Episode 47 - Letters
videos.overview: With Shuvee guiding the discussion, the boys and girls explore their similarities and differences as they take turns answering each other’s questions. Before being reunited, they write letters that express their true thoughts about one another.

videos.title: Episode 48 - Reunited
videos.overview: Despite finally being reunited, the housemates' mood quickly turns somber as they prepare to bid a heartfelt farewell to Shuvee. Soon, they receive their Christmas-themed seventh weekly task.

videos.title: Episode 49 - Elves At Work
videos.overview: The housemates’ patience is put to the test as they work through their seventh weekly task. Later, Big Brother gives the four nominees a chance to do a good deed for a housemate of their choice.

videos.title: Episode 50 - Third Eviction
videos.overview: The housemates race against time to complete their seventh weekly task and give a nominated housemate an opportunity to do a good deed. The journeys of two celebrity teens inside the PBB house come to an end.

videos.title: Episode 51 - FranSeth Visit
videos.overview: Francine Diaz and Seth Fedelin complete a special task during their visit to the PBB house. As the housemates and their guests share a simple holiday feast, Seth looks back on his time as a housemate in his own season.

videos.title: Episode 52 - The Best
videos.overview: Christmas is in the air at the Pinoy Big Brother house as the housemates receive their exciting eighth weekly task. Amid the preparations, the Kapamilya and Kapuso teens must decide which housemates deserve a special gift from Big Brother.

videos.title: Episode 53 - Immunity Task
videos.overview: Big Brother announces the housemates voted to compete for immunity. Soon after, the chosen Kapuso teens go head-to-head in a simple yet challenging immunity task.

videos.title: Episode 54 - Carolling
videos.overview: After the Kapuso housemates take their turn, the chosen Kapamilya teens face off in the immunity task. Soon after, the housemates begin performing Christmas carols as they work to complete their weekly task.

videos.title: Episode 55 - Christmas Story
videos.overview: The spirit of Christmas fills the house as the celebrity teens perform heartfelt carols requested by their loved ones. Later, Big Brother allows the housemates to give a gift to a special person in their lives aside from their family.

videos.title: Episode 56 - Xmas Socks
videos.overview: The housemates work to obtain their Christmas socks and give a meaningful gift to their chosen recipient. The Christmas carolling continues as the girls receive requests from their loved ones, helping them reach the target goal for their weekly task.

videos.title: Episode 57 - Call MeMe Vice
videos.overview: Big Brother surprises the housemates with a special screening of Vice Ganda's new movie "Call Me Mother." The Unkabogable Superstar then drops by the PBB house to chat with the celebrity teens and give them an unforgettable gift.
